answer: What survives to the forge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. A jetty of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zenith of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on homomorphic encryption for private computation.
